terminology.status: existing aesthetic and game title; proposed provenance category
terminology.definition: Under this proposal, an interactive work materially derived from a documented dream experience of its creator or credited creator-team member.
terminology.notes: Name collision is material; no ownership claim.

terminology.definition: A Dreamcore work materially shaped by the creator's own frightening dreams, nightmares, or night terrors and intended as horror.
A game that depicts, simulates, or uses dream-like events or mechanics.
A game involving fictional or personal nightmares; scope varies by creator and platform.
terminology.notes: Does not require the proposed source relationship.

terminology.definition: A game centered on transitional, uncanny, or empty spaces.
Horror using surreal, dreamlike, uncanny, or reality-bending elements.
terminology.notes: Aesthetic/tone category; source may be fictional, generic, or personal.

terminology.definition: A work materially informed by a creator's own life experience.
terminology.notes: Broader than dreams; Dreamcore is a possible subset under this proposal.

terminology.definition: Plain-language alternative to the proposed term.
